fields.discom: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (MSEDCL)

notes: Tests: official MSEDCL LT-IP solar net-meter bill format (English), pages 1 and 2 side by side; page 3 of the PDF is blank. Non-residential (public water works, LT-III A). Consumer number, name, address and pincode are masked with X in the original, so null. Sanctioned load is printed as 4.00 HP; labelled as 2.98 kW (1 HP = 0.746 kW). No phase printed. Units billed 384 = 385 import - 1 export (Total Consumption 384.00; 'Billed: 384.00'). bill_amount_rs is TOTAL CURRENT BILL 2706.79; principal arrears 2054.45 are separate (rounded total 4760.00). History is the 13-month BILLING HISTORY table. The yellow highlight boxes and the 'Billing History' arrow are MSEDCL annotations.
